C-R5-SEARCH-ROUTING-323.IntentSummary: Reuse existing domain openers and add only safe route metadata plus search-state continuity, while reducing always-visible filters through progressive disclosure.

T-001.Title: kafedra-design: make result card primary and filters progressive

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile expose the whole result card as the primary keyboard/click target while Original remains a separate secondary action.
Search text, compact type and active filter chips remain visible; all rare filters live under one disclosure without geometry learning.
A compact К поиску return action is visible after routing away from search.

T-002.Title: kafedra-motion: use no-motion for search routing and return

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No route or filter animation is added; static state and focus are sufficient.

T-003.Title: kafedra-feature: add safe route metadata and context restoration

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Route metadata is derived after ACL filtering and maps child result kinds to existing parent/domain surfaces without exposing a new object.
Search reuses Action Center exact routing and the existing documents view/lifecycle path rather than building a second inspector.
Query, filters, details state, focus and scroll restore after returning; stale response sequencing remains unchanged.
Route failure is rendered inline on the originating result and does not fall through to an unauthorized URL.

T-004.Title: kafedra-design-audit: verify continuity and secondary Original action

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Meeting/plan/assignment/document reuse their existing working card and the return action restores the exact search context on desktop and mobile.
Keyboard Enter opens the primary result; activating Original never also opens the domain route.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: cover route kinds ACL stale responses and return state

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit tests cover route target derivation for document/meeting/assignment/periodic/plan child types and no route for unknown result.
Browser regression covers click, Enter, Original isolation, filter disclosure, return state and unavailable target message.
